tasks.short: Monitor power-plant equipment and indicators for operating problems.

steps.what: Retrieve verified equipment indicator trends and current approved operating limits
inputs: actual equipment/tag identity
actual historian readings and current approved limits

steps.what: Monitor actual power plant equipment and indicators to detect operating problems
inputs: checked operating indicator view
actual equipment condition and local observations
outputs: actual observed operating conditions and human problem assessment

steps.what: Capture and check actual assigned operating-problem observations
inputs: actual observed operating conditions and human problem assessment
outputs: checked final actual operating observation record

steps.what: Save checked final actual operating observation record
inputs: checked final actual operating observation record

tasks.design: Configure native read-only trend/limit views in plant monitoring {OPS_SYSTEM} and historian {DATA_PLATFORM}. Retain physical monitoring, problem judgement and all new observation capture/check before a separate log save; no control or protection changes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding matching trends and limits can repeat screen navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native verified trend views can reduce navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Actual abnormal equipment behaviour needs operator judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The operator combines a local condition with an indicator trend that alone is ambiguous.
tasks.altitude: Less indicator-navigation effort during human monitoring.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native historian trend views can reduce navigation; operator monitoring and equipment judgement remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Existing historian producer supplies tag, timestamp, unit, value and quality; operator checks identity/currency and uses manual instruments when missing or suspect. Approved limits come from actual controlled procedures.

Only repeated view navigation reduced; existing native view earns zero new saving. Actual logs shared with 12324 counted once; remove unowned record branch and reweight. Any actual alert/escalation or control is a separate final-state gated action, not assumed here.
research_questions: Can native trend views reduce lookup without reducing actual monitoring?

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final actual observation record and log destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 20*0.50=10 gross minus1 upkeep; low halves gross. Monitoring, new capture/check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: Configure equipment-linked current log views in operations logbook {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. Retain full substantive reading, actual personnel communication, status judgement and new assessment checking before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status assessment can repeat log navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Missing or conflicting accounts need actual clarification.
tasks.human_edge: The operator recognises that an old normal-status entry does not establish current condition.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native equipment-linked logs can reduce lookup; status assessment and actual personnel communication remain human.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual operators produce logs and current accounts; checking source timestamp/equipment identity and substantive reading remain. Existing native links earn zero saving.

Logs/communication are actual alternative routes: remove unused branch and reweight. Assigned status-record only where required and counted once with 12324. No automatic operating instruction or return-to-service inferred.
research_questions: Does native linkage reduce navigation after full log reading?

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final status assessment and log destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 25*0.50=12.5 gross minus1 upkeep; low halves gross. Full reading, conversation, judgement and new record retained.

tasks.short: Record and compile actual operational data into forms, logs and reports.

inputs: actual field equipment and rounds
actual operator-observed events and reasons

steps.what: Transfer existing historian operating values into operational report draft fields
inputs: actual existing historian values: tag, timestamp, value, units and quality
actual selected equipment and report interval

steps.what: Compile forms, logs and reports using native fixed report sections and checked formulas
inputs: source-linked operational data fields
actual operator-produced field facts
actual controlled report definitions

steps.what: Check complete final operational report, missing values, units, intervals and destination
inputs: compiled operational report draft
actual source values and field observations
outputs: checked final operational report and exact internal destination

steps.what: Commit final operational forms, logs or reports
inputs: checked final operational report and exact internal destination

steps.what: Deliver final operational report to its actual internal recipient
inputs: checked final operational report and exact internal destination

tasks.design: Use native historian/report links first; where actual re-keying remains, transfer historian {DATA_PLATFORM} values into operating-report drafts {OPS_SYSTEM}. Keep primary field capture and complete report checking before separate commit and actual internal delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operational reporting can re-key recorded values and repeat report assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing historian values and native report definitions support deterministic transfer and compilation.
tasks.still_hard: Uninstrumented conditions, missing data and correct interval interpretation require operators.
tasks.human_edge: The operator rejects a plausible summary built from the wrong equipment or interval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: historian-to-log transfer and native report compilation can remove repeated entry where fields are already recorded.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Actual historian producer supplies tag, timestamp/timezone, value, units and quality; require approved tag/interval mapping, deduplication and missing-value flags. Missing/stale/bad-quality source returns to retained manual lookup/entry, never invented readings.

Actual operator produces new field observations and reasons in s1; no free capture. Native existing import/compilation earns zero new saving. Shared observations/records with 12314/12320 counted once.

Forms/logs/reports and actual delivery routes reweight the work actually owned. No external compliance submission or operating control implied. Each actual additional send or control needs its own exact-final-version gate.
unknowns: Which values are actually re-keyed today?
research_questions: Can source-linked transfer remove duplicate entry after full report checking?

incremental.description: Maintain tag/report mappings and review missing/quality exceptions.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final operational report and record destination; edits void check
s4 exact final operational report and actual internal recipient; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 30 duplicate transfer+20*0.50 compilation=40 gross minus1.5 upkeep; low halves gross. Primary capture, complete checks and actions retained.

tasks.design: Configure native current-indicator and instruction links in plant coordination {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. Retain coordination judgement and final-message checking before actual operator communication, then record only actual responses/outcomes before a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coordination preparation can repeat indicator/instruction navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked current views can reduce lookup.
tasks.still_hard: Voltage/load/frequency coordination depends on actual system state and authorised operators.
tasks.human_edge: The operator recognises that conditions invalidate a previously chosen coordination proposal.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native coordination-context links can reduce lookup; actual system coordination and control remain operator work.

assumptions: Provisional shares. Existing indicator producers and controlled instruction owners supply actual sources; operator checks timestamp, tag identity and currency, falls back manually if absent. Existing views earn zero new saving.

Internal systems operators shown; actual external control-room recipient uses external-send authority with same final-state gate. Any new outbound message returns to s3/s4. Actual switching/control enactment is not automated or inferred; each actual action separately authorised.

Outcome exists only after actual response/state confirmation. Assigned record only if required and counted once with12324; remove unused branch and reweight. Existing final-message check adds no separate approval ceremony.
research_questions: Can native links reduce preparation after full current-state verification?

approvals.approved_version: s3 exact final coordination message, actual recipient and current conditions; changes require recheck
s6 exact final actual coordination outcome record and log destination; edits void check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15*0.40=6 gross minus0.5 upkeep; low halves gross. All actual coordination, judgement, final checking and actions retained.
